labels.swarmItem: label-layout-margin, labelline-smooth-reset, pie-tangential-noflip — pie/label-layout area, grouped to avoid file conflicts (src/chart/pie/labelLayout.ts, src/label/labelLayoutHelper.ts, src/chart/pie/PieSeries.ts and related type declarations); three separate commits in the listed order. Details: (a) label-layout-margin: make label layout margin handling consistent — minMargin, textMargin, stroke-aware bounding, and hidden-overlap handling must use the final post-layout label geometry everywhere (shared label layout code and pie labels). (b) labelline-smooth-reset: fix that pie labelLine.smooth, once turned on, cannot be reset — setting smooth back to false/0 must restore a straight guide line on option update (look at where the label line path points are recomputed in src/chart/pie/labelLayout.ts; the stale smooth flag/points are likely not cleared). (c) pie-tangential-noflip: add a label.rotate mode 'tangential-noflip' for pie series that keeps labels tangential to the slice but never flips them to the opposite reading direction; update the rotation logic in labelLayout and the TypeScript option types so the new string value is accepted.

matrix-label-api, matrix-label-formatter — matrix coordinate/series code (src/coord/matrix/, src/chart/matrix/, related types); two separate commits in the listed order. Details: (a) matrix-label-api: matrix labels must inherit option.textStyle defaults the same way other labels do (check how other series/coords wire textStyle into labels), and matrix coordinate lookup must handle missing or out-of-range locator values predictably, including the coordClamp path, instead of producing invalid ranges. (b) matrix-label-formatter: matrix label.formatter currently has no effect — make both string-template and function formatters apply to matrix labels, and ensure formatter callbacks receive the documented context (name, value, coord).

js-yaml-3-14-2, validator-13-15-23, typescript-esm-compatibility, release-6-0-0-rc1, release-merge-master, license-headers-precommit — all packaging/tooling chores sharing package.json / package-lock.json / build tooling, grouped to one agent to avoid file conflicts; six separate commits in the listed order. Details: (a) js-yaml-3-14-2: bump devDependency js-yaml from 3.14.0 to 3.14.2 in package.json and package-lock.json (use `npm install --package-lock-only` or careful consistent edits; do not break the lockfile). (b) validator-13-15-23: same for validator 13.15.20 -> 13.15.23. (c) typescript-esm-compatibility: remove `export =`-style export assignment from the published type entrypoints (inspect index.d.ts, package.json `types`/`exports`) so modern TypeScript ESM resolution works, providing distinct ESM/CJS declaration paths if needed; match the upstream fix 'remove export assignment to support typescript esm compatibility'. (d) release-6-0-0-rc1: bump version 6.0.0-beta.1 -> 6.0.0-rc.1 in package.json (and package-lock.json) as the release-candidate packaging. (e) release-merge-master: post-release maintenance merge onto the main line after the 6.0.0 release — in this repo that means finalizing packaging metadata to the released 6.0.0 baseline (version 6.0.0 in package.json/package-lock) with no behavior changes; inspect git log for context. (f) license-headers-precommit: add Apache license-header checking tooling — e.g. a script (under build/ or a dev dependency already present like husky/lint-staged if the repo uses them — check package.json and .husky first) plus pre-commit wiring that fails with an actionable message when a required license header is missing; check how existing build/*.js files carry Apache headers and follow that convention. Investigate the repo before deciding each detail.

logscale-negative-exponent-rounding — log scale numeric rounding. Fix incorrect rounding usage and support data with big negative exponents in the log scale (src/scale/Log.ts, src/util/number.ts, possibly src/scale/Interval.ts). A log axis fed very small values must not mis-round; ticks and labels stay stable across the supported exponent range. NOTE: a prior commit 'impl: cartesian-small-number-rounding' already modified src/scale/Log.ts and src/util/number.ts — build on the current state, do not revert it. Add a focused test if practical.

radar-clockwise-option — add a `clockwise` option to the radar coordinate system (src/coord/radar/Radar.ts, src/coord/radar/RadarModel.ts, radar view/label code and TypeScript option types as needed). Setting radar.clockwise chooses the direction in which indicators are laid out; the default must preserve today's rendering, and label placement plus the rest of the radar rendering contract must keep working in both directions. First determine the current default direction from the code, then wire the option through consistently.
